Update ToastProvider in src/components/Toast.tsx to separate toasts by type, using `role="alert" aria-live="assertive"` for error toasts and disabling auto-dismissal for errors so they remain until explicitly dismissed by the user.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use an assertive live region and remain visible until dismissed, whereas src/components/Toast.tsx currently treats them as polite and auto-dismisses them after 5 seconds.
